A hectic shift ahead, a few reminders
The subject is staff rotas
Travelers on animal bookings need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is on tight turnaround, so please bring every form, crate note, and health detail in good order before you come through.

We are keeping things calm and steady for the pets, because that is how the work stays safe. Handlers will use humane methods, and the desk will keep each handoff moving with as little stress as possible. If you are traveling with a pet, stay close to the desk instructions and do not split your papers between bags.

Aurelia Skyways moves people between skyports, and that means the paperwork has to travel just as cleanly as the passengers do. If you are checking in with a pet like Buddy, or making a fresh change to an existing booking, let the staff know right away so we can line up the right support. Quick answers help everyone, especially when the cabin plan shifts and the animal area needs a fresh look.

Keep your carriers secure, your labels easy to read, and your contact details current. Small mistakes create big delays, and we do not want that for you or for the animals in our care.

If you need help, go straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
